items.title: Capital One Financial (COF) Joins Banks Warning On AI Shopping Agent Risks
items.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE: COF) joined a coalition of global banks warning about risks from AI shopping agents acting for customers. The group highlighted concerns that AI-powered purchasing tools could increase exposure to scams, fraud and data privacy breaches. Banks in the coalition are calling for clearer disclosure standards and customer safeguards when AI agents initiate or authorize financial transactions.
